script:
# Note: ERPNext Server Scripts cannot use import statements or restricted helpers.

DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE = "Factory - T"

def to_float(val):
    try:
        return float(val or 0)
    except:
        return 0.0

def dbg(stage, docname, msg):
    frappe.msgprint(f"[{stage}] [{docname}] {msg}")

stage = "INIT"
created = []

try:
    pp_name = doc.name
    mr_items = doc.get("mr_items") or []
    po_items = doc.get("po_items") or []

    if not mr_items:
        frappe.throw("No MR Items found — please populate MR Items before submitting.")

    # --- Collect all MR items grouped by their parent ---
    parentwise_rm = {}
    for mr in mr_items:
        parent = mr.get("custom_parent_item") or "EXTRA"
        code = mr.get("item_code")
        adj = to_float(mr.get("custom_adjusted_qty"))
        if not code or adj <= 0:
            continue
        if not parentwise_rm.get(parent):
            parentwise_rm[parent] = {}
        parentwise_rm[parent][code] = parentwise_rm[parent].get(code, 0) + adj

    # --- Loop through Production Order items ---
    for po in po_items:
        stage = "SE-Preflight"
        qty = to_float(po.get("planned_qty"))
        item_code = po.get("item_code")
        bom_no = po.get("bom_no")

        if qty <= 0 or not item_code or not bom_no:
            continue

        totals = parentwise_rm.get(item_code, {})

        # Merge EXTRA items into this SE
        extra_items = parentwise_rm.get("EXTRA", {})
        if extra_items:
            for code, req_qty in extra_items.items():
                totals[code] = totals.get(code, 0) + req_qty

        # --- Create Stock Entry ---
        stage = "SE-Create"
        se = frappe.new_doc("Stock Entry")
        se.stock_entry_type = "Manufacture"
        se.company = doc.company
        se.bom_no = bom_no
        se.fg_completed_qty = qty
        se.set_posting_time = 1
        se.posting_date = doc.posting_date or frappe.utils.today()
        se.remarks = "Auto Manufacture Entry from Production Plan " + pp_name
        se.custom_production_plan = pp_name

        # --- Add Raw Materials (including merged EXTRA items) ---
        for code, req_qty in (totals or {}).items():
            res = frappe.db.get_value("Item", code, ["stock_uom", "item_name"], as_dict=True) or {}
            stock_uom = res.get("stock_uom") or "Nos"
            item_name = res.get("item_name") or code

            se.append("items", {
                "item_code": code,
                "item_name": item_name,
                "s_warehouse": DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE,
                "qty": to_float(req_qty),
                "uom": stock_uom,
                "stock_uom": stock_uom,
                "conversion_factor": 1.0,
            })

        # --- Add Finished Good ---
        fg_uom = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item_code, "stock_uom") or "Nos"
        se.append("items", {
            "item_code": item_code,
            "is_finished_item": 1,
            "t_warehouse": DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE,
            "qty": qty,
            "uom": fg_uom,
            "stock_uom": fg_uom,
            "conversion_factor": 1.0,
        })

        # --- Validate Finished Good row ---
        stage = "SE-Validate"
        has_fg = False
        for i in se.items:
            if i.get("is_finished_item") in (1, "1"):
                has_fg = True
                break
        if not has_fg:
            frappe.throw("[" + stage + "] Missing Finished Good row for " + item_code)

        # --- Insert & Submit Stock Entry ---
        stage = "SE-Submit"
        se.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        se.submit()
        dbg(stage, pp_name, "SE " + se.name + " submitted for " + item_code)
        created.append(se.name)

    # --- Finalize ---
    if created:
        frappe.msgprint("✅ Auto Manufacture Stock Entries:\n" + "\n".join(created))

    doc.db_set("status", "Closed")
    dbg("PP-Close", pp_name, "Production Plan closed successfully")

except Exception as e:
    frappe.throw("[" + stage + "] " + str(e))

script:
@frappe.whitelist()
def get_bom_items_sql(bom_no):
    """Get BOM items using SQL query"""
    query = """
        SELECT 
            bi.item_code, 
            bi.item_name, 
            bi.qty, 
            bi.rate,
            bi.uom,
            bi.description,
            item.stock_uom
        FROM `tabBOM Item` bi
        JOIN `tabItem` item ON bi.item_code = item.name
        WHERE bi.parent = %s
        ORDER BY bi.idx
    """
    
    bom_items = frappe.db.sql(query, bom_no, as_dict=True)
    return bom_items

if doc.workflow_state == 'Approved':
    # 1. Check if a Delivery Note already exists for this Order
    # We ignore Cancelled (docstatus=2) Delivery Notes
    if not frappe.db.exists("Delivery Note", {"against_sales_order": doc.name, "docstatus": ["!=", 2]}):
        
        try:
            # 2. Create a new empty Delivery Note
            dn = frappe.new_doc("Delivery Note")
            dn.posting_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
            dn.company = doc.company
            dn.customer = doc.customer
            dn.currency = doc.currency
            dn.selling_price_list = doc.selling_price_list
            
            # 3. Loop through Sales Order items and add them to Delivery Note
            for item in doc.items:
                # Only map items that are not "Service" (optional check)
                dn_item = dn.append("items", {})
                dn_item.item_code = item.item_code
                dn_item.item_name = item.item_name
                dn_item.description = item.description
                dn_item.uom = item.uom
                dn_item.conversion_factor = item.conversion_factor
                dn_item.qty = item.qty
                dn_item.rate = item.rate
                dn_item.warehouse = item.warehouse
                
                # CRITICAL: These two lines link the DN item back to the SO item
                # This ensures the "Delivered %" updates correctly on the Sales Order
                dn_item.against_sales_order = doc.name
                dn_item.so_detail = item.name 

            # 4. Save (Insert) the document
            dn.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

            frappe.msgprint(f"Delivery Note {dn.name} created successfully.")

        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(title="Manual DN Create Failed", message=str(e))
